questions.questionText: Object-Oriented Programming is a programming approach where:
options: Objects are used instead of logic alone
questions.correctAnswer: Objects are used instead of logic alone
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Objects are used instead of logic alone.

questions.questionText: Which are the four pillars of OOP mentioned in the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Inheritance, Polymorphism, Abstraction, Encapsulation.

questions.questionText: The aim of OOP is to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Reduce the complexity of programming.

questions.questionText: A class in Dart is:
options: A user-defined data type describing the behaviour and characteristics of an entity
questions.correctAnswer: A user-defined data type describing the behaviour and characteristics of an entity
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A user-defined data type describing the behaviour and characteristics of an entity.

questions.questionText: A class comprises:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Data members and member functions.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to create a class in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) class.

questions.questionText: When an instance of a class is created, it is called a(n):
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Object.

questions.questionText: In Dart, the new keyword for creating objects is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Optional and can be omitted.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct syntax for creating an object?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) ClassName ObjectName = ClassName();.

questions.questionText: An instance variable:
options: Can have a different value for each object
questions.correctAnswer: Can have a different value for each object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Can have a different value for each object.

questions.questionText: A class variable is declared using which keyword?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) static.

questions.questionText: A class variable has:
options: A different value for every object
Only one value shared among all objects
A value that is deleted after each call
questions.correctAnswer: Only one value shared among all objects
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Only one value shared among all objects.

questions.questionText: The value of a class (static) variable is retained until:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The program terminates.

questions.questionText: Methods in Dart help to:
options: Divide large programs into smaller parts and increase code reusability
questions.correctAnswer: Divide large programs into smaller parts and increase code reusability
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Divide large programs into smaller parts and increase code reusability.

questions.questionText: A static (class) method is called:
options: Directly using the class name, without creating an object
questions.correctAnswer: Directly using the class name, without creating an object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Directly using the class name, without creating an object.

questions.questionText: Which keyword declares a class method?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) static.

questions.questionText: Instance methods can be accessed:
options: Using an object of the class
questions.correctAnswer: Using an object of the class
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Using an object of the class.

questions.questionText: The signature of an instance method consists of:
options: Its name, return type and parameter list
questions.correctAnswer: Its name, return type and parameter list
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Its name, return type and parameter list.

questions.questionText: What is printed by Student.printName("Eliza"); when printName is a static method that prints its argument?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Eliza.

questions.questionText: Which keyword defines a getter in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) get.

questions.questionText: Which keyword defines a setter in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) set.

questions.questionText: A getter method is used to:
options: Get, read or retrieve class fields
questions.correctAnswer: Get, read or retrieve class fields
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Get, read or retrieve class fields.

questions.questionText: A setter method is used to:
options: Set, write or initialize class fields
questions.correctAnswer: Set, write or initialize class fields
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Set, write or initialize class fields.

questions.questionText: The keyword used to inherit properties from a parent class is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) extends.

questions.questionText: The class that inherits from another class is called the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Child class.

questions.questionText: Which two types of inheritance are described in the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Single-level and multi-level.

questions.questionText: In multi-level inheritance:
options: A class is inherited from another child class
questions.correctAnswer: A class is inherited from another child class
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A class is inherited from another child class.

questions.questionText: Polymorphism refers to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) One object having many forms.

questions.questionText: Dart supports polymorphism through:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Method overriding.

questions.questionText: Which annotation is used when a child class overrides a parent method?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) @override.

questions.questionText: An interface is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A blueprint of a class.

questions.questionText: In Dart, interfaces are defined:
options: Implicitly – every class defines an interface
Only with abstract methods in packages
questions.correctAnswer: Implicitly – every class defines an interface
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Implicitly – every class defines an interface.

questions.questionText: Which keyword forces a class to redefine all methods of the class it uses as an interface?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) implements.

questions.questionText: Abstraction in OOP means:
options: Hiding unnecessary information and showing only important information
questions.correctAnswer: Hiding unnecessary information and showing only important information
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Hiding unnecessary information and showing only important information.

questions.questionText: Which keyword creates an abstract class in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) abstract.

questions.questionText: A class declared as abstract cannot be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Instantiated (initialized).

questions.questionText: A constructor has:
options: A different name than the class
The same name as the class
questions.correctAnswer: The same name as the class
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The same name as the class.

questions.questionText: A constructor is called:
options: Automatically when an object is created
questions.correctAnswer: Automatically when an object is created
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Automatically when an object is created.

questions.questionText: Constructors must not have:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A return type.

questions.questionText: Which are the three types of constructors in Dart?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Default, parameterized and named.

questions.questionText: A default constructor is one that:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Has no parameters.

questions.questionText: A parameterized constructor:
options: Takes arguments used to initialize the object
questions.correctAnswer: Takes arguments used to initialize the object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Takes arguments used to initialize the object.

questions.questionText: Which constructor allows multiple constructors with different names in the same class?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Named constructor.

questions.questionText: If a user creates their own constructor, the default constructor:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Is ignored.

questions.questionText: The this keyword refers to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The current class object.

questions.questionText: The this keyword is used to:
options: Remove ambiguity between parameters and attributes with the same name
questions.correctAnswer: Remove ambiguity between parameters and attributes with the same name
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Remove ambiguity between parameters and attributes with the same name.

questions.questionText: The super keyword is used to:
options: Refer to the parent class object, its methods and properties
questions.correctAnswer: Refer to the parent class object, its methods and properties
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Refer to the parent class object, its methods and properties.

questions.questionText: In the super keyword example, print(super.subject); prints:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Example of Super Keyword.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT true about Dart?
options: An abstract class cannot be instantiated
A child class inherits properties and methods of the parent class
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Dart supports method overloading.

questions.questionText: In the code where class Student extends Human overrides the say() method with @override, which OOP concept is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Polymorphism.
